terms.title: Terms & refunds · GetDuoNow
terms.sub: Short version: we watch, we alert, you buy. No restock during your watch? We extend it free; still none? Full refund.
terms.whatP: We check Apple Store in-store pickup stock about every 30 seconds for the models and stores you pick, and alert you by text and email when one becomes available. You order from Apple yourself — we never buy, reserve or hold a phone for you, and stock can sell out before you check out.
terms.appleP: GetDuoNow is an independent service. Not affiliated with Apple Inc., and not endorsed or sponsored by Apple. Apple, Apple Store and iPhone are trademarks of Apple Inc.
terms.priceP: One-time payment for a watch pass: {price} for {days} days of watching. No subscription, nothing renews automatically.
terms.priceFree: Right now watches are free and last {days} days — no payment is taken.
terms.refundP: If your watch ends without a single in-stock alert, we automatically extend it once for free, for the same length. If the extension also ends without an alert, reply to any GetDuoNow email within 7 days for a full refund.
terms.sms3: Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help.
terms.sms4: Consent to receive texts is not a condition of purchase.
terms.privacyP: We keep only your email, phone number and the stores and models you picked, and use them only to send your alerts. We never sell your data. Mobile numbers and SMS opt-in consent are never shared with or sold to third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. Reply to any GetDuoNow email to have your data deleted.
terms.contactP: Questions? Email {email} or reply to any GetDuoNow email — a person will get back to you.
terms.translationNote: If a translation differs from the English version, the English version applies.
